documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting On 13.11.2026
Monthly Report On Special Window Re-Lodgement Of Shares- September, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Aries Agro reported a 17.22% increase in standalone gross revenue for FY 2024-25, driven by international sales and import substitution initiatives. The company is targeting Rs. 950 crores in gross revenue for FY 2025-26, supported by Rs. 830.44 crores in annual bookings already recorded. Management noted that erratic monsoon patterns have impacted the Kharif 2025 season, leading to a mixed outlook for yields and demand.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting Rs. 950 crores in gross revenue for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: We are targeting Rs. 950 crores in gross revenue for the current year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that cost control measures along with revamping the UAE facility and the domestic business will increase revenue and profitability.
guidance.quote: Cost control measures along with continued focus on revamping the UAE facility with domestic business will show increase in revenue and profitability

guidance.claim: The operations of GHME in the UAE subsidiary are expected to start in December 2019.
guidance.quote: In regards to the UAE Subsidiary, the operations of GHME are expected to start in the month of December 2019 as required permission for merchant trading expected towards the end of November 2019.

guidance.claim: Continuous power facilities at the Amarak Chemicals FZC facility at Fujairah are anticipated to be operational by December 15th.
guidance.quote: As for Amarak Chemicals FZC facility at Fujairah, we anticipate requisite facilities of continuous power to be operational by 15th December, which shall help us kick start our manufacturing activities.

demand_outlook.claim: Erratic monsoon patterns have caused delays in sowing and crop stress, resulting in a mixed outlook for yields.
demand_outlook.quote: This uneven pattern has significantly influenced the Kharif 2025 season, leading to delays in sowing in some states, crop stress in others, and a mixed outlook for yields overall.

demand_outlook.claim: Fluctuations in weather have impacted the timing and intensity of demand for agri-inputs.
demand_outlook.quote: For the agri-input industry, such fluctuations have impacted the timing and intensity of demand, underlining once again the importance of agile supply chains, farmer engagement, and product positioning that can withstand the unpredictability of climate trends.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenues grew by 15 percent on a year-on-year basis despite a short duration of the Kharif season.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite a short duration of the Kharif season we have still managed to ramp up the revenues by 15% on Y-o-Y basis.

capex_expansion.claim: The company signed a contract for a new Sulphur Bentonite facility in Jebel Ali, UAE.
capex_expansion.quote: We signed a contract for a new Sulphur Bentonite facility in Jebel Ali, UAE, broke ground on a new plant in Lucknow, and expanded our office in Vijayawada.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted a continued focus on revamping the UAE facility.
capex_expansion.quote: Cost control measures along with continued focus on revamping the UAE facility with domestic business will show increase in revenue and profitability

margins_costs.claim: The company reduced its percentage of imported raw materials from 51% in 2018-19 to 18% in 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: Our Make In India and import substitution initiatives have reduced our percentage of imported raw materials from 51pc in 2018-19 to 18pc in 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: Net margin has remained consistent due to sector dependence on external natural factors like rain and seasonal crop patterns.
margins_costs.quote: Net margin has been consistent and echoing performance of earlier comparable period, largely due to sector dependence on external natural factors like rain coupled with seasonal crop pattern.

orders_capacity.claim: Domestic capacity utilization was 76.32% of the 95,400 MT per annum installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Our domestic capacity utilization stood at 76.32% of the 95,400 MT p.a. installed capacity, and our UAE plant produced 8,751 MT of Sulphur Bentonite and other value-added Sulphur products for both Indian and global markets.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has recorded Rs. 830.44 crores in annual bookings for FY 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Annual Booking for FY 2025-26 has already recorded bookings worth Rs. 830.44 crores from 1,717 dealers across 26 states.

orders_capacity.claim: A novel marketing model called Flash sales operating over a digital platform has led to consistent revenue growth with a conversion rate of 75% to 80% of the order book.
orders_capacity.quote: A Novel marketing model called “Flash sales” operating over digital platform is backed by strong brand name of Aries Agro and robust product range which has led to consistent growth in the revenues for the company. This has also shown a promising trend with a conversion rate of 75% to 80% of the order book.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces potential inverted duty structures on select inputs due to GST 2.0 reforms.
risks_headwinds.quote: While there may be some cases of inverted duty structures arising on select inputs and products, the Company’s diverse and balanced portfolio is expected to mitigate any significant adverse impact on GST-related cash outflows.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve Rs. 950 crores in gross revenue for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting Rs. 950 crores in gross revenue for the current year.

management_commitments.claim: The operations of GHME are expected to start in the month of December 2019.
management_commitments.quote: In regards to the UAE Subsidiary, the operations of GHME are expected to start in the month of December 2019 as required permission for merchant trading expected towards the end of November 2019.

management_commitments.claim: Requisite facilities of continuous power at Amarak Chemicals FZC facility at Fujairah are anticipated to be operational by 15th December.
management_commitments.quote: As for Amarak Chemicals FZC facility at Fujairah, we anticipate requisite facilities of continuous power to be operational by 15th December, which shall help us kick start our manufacturing activities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
